question: Should OpenClaw keep live log-tail and command-output as first-party modular dashboard builtins, and should they wait for the stream/command binding API before implementation?
rationale: Current main has related logs and terminal surfaces but not the dashboard substrate; exposing logs and command output inside composable widgets is both product-shaping and security-sensitive.

options.title: Sequence After Dashboard And Bindings
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement after the dashboard substrate plus stream/command binding security contract are reviewed.

options.title: Narrow To Logs First
options.body: Approve a smaller logs-only builtin using `logs.tail` polling while deferring command-output widgets until command binding policy is settled.

options.title: Move Out Of Core
options.body: Decline first-party builtins and ask for a ClawHub/plugin experiment if maintainers do not want dashboard cells to expose operational output in core.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Dashboard And Bindings
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement after the dashboard substrate plus stream/command binding security contract are reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current bundled plugin-tab seam and is the strongest current-main owner signal for the dashboard plugin-tab boundary.
